description: Active-workout 'N sets left, about M min' golden cases run by Android RemainingWorkoutEstimateGoldenTest and iOS RemainingWorkoutEstimateGoldenTests. Input: for each exercise of the active workout, remainingSets = its sets not yet recorded (negative counts as 0). setsLeft = sum of remainingSets. exercisesLeft = number of exercises with remainingSets > 0. When setsLeft is 0 the estimate is absent (null) and the line is hidden. Otherwise minutes = max(1, minutesPerExercise * exercisesLeft + minutesPerSet * setsLeft). This is the same flat model as the plan-duration estimate min(90, max(10, 3 * exerciseCount + 2 * setCount)) in shared/training-minutes-v1.json applied to the remaining work, without that estimate's 10-minute floor and 90-minute cap (plan-sanity bounds that would turn one remaining set into '~10 min'). The model works in whole minutes, so there is no seconds rounding; no per-exercise rest is added because the base estimate has none. A running rest timer is ignored.
